messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 8 of Act 3/2016, amending s12 (Grounds for challenge.)
Instruction (start): for sub-section (1), the following sub-section shall be substituted, namely:— “(1) When a person is approached in connection with his possible appointment as an arbitrator, he shall disclose in writing any circumstances,— (a) such as the existence either direct or indirect, of any past or present relationship with or interest in any of the parties or in relation to the subject-matter in dispute, w

Source: Notes on Clauses, The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2015 (as introduced) (Government)
Quote: Clause 8 of the Bill seeks to amend section 12 of the principal Act to ensure neutrality of
arbitrators.

Claim: The amendment seeks to ensure neutrality of arbitrators.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"The quote explicitly states the amendment’s purpose is to ensure arbitrator neutrality, matching the claim."}
